text: Being here, I perceive a sense of modernity and intention. The glass-walled meeting space feels open yet separate—a paradox of connection and isolation. Moving further, the bold colors and focus on 'R+D' engulf me in curiosity—a declaration that innovation is not only encouraged but celebrated. I sense a deliberate cultivation of inquiry, an invitation to participate in both conversation and contemplation. I feel intrigued, alert, and somewhat inspired by the environment’s subtle encouragement to think more deeply.
